tool.title: BPMN checklist projection
tool.description: Generate, per diagram, a checklist that walks the BPMN as a state machine: each task names the `workflow_complete` call that records it and ends with `next:` by node id; each decision lists its labelled branches (or the DMN that computes it); parallel forks name every branch and joins wait for all; start/end events are entry and exit lines. A rendering, never an authority: it says it is generated, and `--check` fails when one is stale.

inputs.name: out
inputs.description: Write every `<stem>.checklist.md` into this one directory instead. Default: each beside its diagram, in the layer that owns it; the harness site's `assets/workflows/checklists` holds those of the layers below the harness.

inputs.name: check
inputs.description: Verify instead of write: exit 1 on a stale, missing or orphaned checklist.

outputs.name: checklists
outputs.description: One committed `<stem>.checklist.md` per diagram in every layer, beside its `.bpmn`.

selection.when: A coding agent needs a process in a form it can follow without reading BPMN XML, or without the engine's MCP server.
selection.limits: Conditions are the flows' labels or the DMN's id; a condition expression the model does not carry is not reproduced. The engine stays the authority.
selection.cost: One diagram load per process; no network.
